issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: PageIndex
products.tagline: Accurate, trustworthy answers across professional documents
products.summaryZh: 在专业文档中提供准确、可信的答案
products.descriptionZh: PageIndex 能在您工作中依赖的长篇专业文档中，提供准确、可信的答案。导入您的全部文档集，提出最棘手的问题，点击任意引用即可跳转到精确高亮的源文行，几秒内即可验证。
products.description: PageIndex gives you accurate, trustworthy answers across long, professional documents your work depends on. Bring in your entire document set, ask your hardest question, and click any citation to jump to the exact highlighted source line, so you can verify it in seconds.

products.name: Caddi
products.tagline: Agent that builds agents by only showing your work only once
products.summaryZh: 仅通过一次展示你的工作，即可构建代理的代理
products.descriptionZh: Caddi将口述录屏转化为生产代理，在您的真实工具中运行后台工作。只需演示一次任务，Caddi即可学习流程、构建自动化，并允许您用通俗英语进行更新。与需要范围界定、开发人员和逐步设置的RPA或工作流构建器不同，Caddi结合了AI推理与确定性执行，每次运行均有记录，每项权限均受范围控制。
products.description: Caddi turns narrated screenshares into production agents that run back-office work across your real tools. Show the task once, and Caddi learns the process, builds the automation, and lets you update it in plain English. Unlike RPA or workflow builders that require scoping, developers, and step-by-step setup, Caddi combines AI reasoning with deterministic execution, with every run logged and every permission scoped.

products.name: Microduck
products.tagline: A tiny open-source biped you can train yourself
products.summaryZh: 一个可自行训练的小型开源双足机器人
products.descriptionZh: Microduck是一款25厘米高、售价399美元的开源双足机器人，由Hugging Face和Pollen Robotics共同打造。它专为仿真到现实的强化学习设计，出厂预装7种预训练行为，并附带Apache 2.0软件栈，用户可克隆、修改并重新训练。
products.description: Microduck is a 25cm, $399 open-source bipedal robot built by Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics. It’s designed for sim-to-real reinforcement learning. It ships with 7 pre-trained behaviors and an Apache 2.0 software stack you can clone, modify, and retrain.

products.name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
products.tagline: Our newest multimodal model for video generation and editing
products.summaryZh: 我们最新的多模态模型，用于视频生成与编辑。
products.descriptionZh: Omni现在提供工作室级视频制作功能，包括场景扩展、首尾帧插值、清晰的4K升级、更快的原型制作等。
products.description: Omni now delivers studio-quality video production, including the ability to extend a scene, first and last frame interpolation, crisp 4K upscaling, faster prototyping, and more.

products.name: OpenTag
products.tagline: AI coworker lives on Slack and Teams
products.summaryZh: AI同事常驻于Slack和Teams
products.descriptionZh: OpenTag是一款AI同事，它存在于你的团队协作之处。它全面了解你的公司情况，因此能接手团队的工作，减轻团队负担。
products.description: OpenTag is an AI coworker that lives where your team collaborates. It has full context on your company, so it takes actions and real work off your team's plate.

products.name: Firecrawl Developer Index
products.tagline: A curated index of 70M+ artifacts for coding agents.
products.summaryZh: 为编码代理精选的7000万+工件索引。
products.descriptionZh: 从一个端点搜索超过7000万个GitHub README、问题、拉取请求和文档。任何编码专用索引中召回率最高，无需API密钥即可开始使用。该索引现已在API、CLI和MCP上的/v2/search/developer上线。准备好与您所有喜爱的编码代理集成！
products.description: Search 70M+ GitHub READMEs, issues, pull requests, and documentation from one endpoint. The highest recall of any coding-specific index, with no API key needed to start. The index is live now at /v2/search/developer on the API, CLI, and MCP. Ready to integrate with all your favorite coding agents!

products.name: Almanac
products.tagline: The agent with a second brain
products.summaryZh: 拥有第二大脑的智能体
products.descriptionZh: Almanac是一个了解你公司的人工智能代理。一键连接你的账户，它便从你的工作中构建一个自我更新的“大脑”，然后存在于Slack和iMessage中，真正完成任务。它拥有自己的计算机，因此即使你合上笔记本电脑，它也能继续工作。
products.description: Almanac is an AI agent that knows your company. Connect your accounts in one click and it builds a self-updating "brain" from your work, then lives in Slack & iMessage to actually get tasks done. It has its own computer, so it keeps working after you close your laptop.

products.name: Aramb
products.tagline: Build, launch and monetize your AI agents in 20 minutes
products.summaryZh: 在20分钟内构建、发布并变现你的AI智能体。
products.descriptionZh: Aramb是面向AI代理的操作系统。雇佣AI代理，或通过一行代码（npm install @aramb-ai/sdk）构建自己的代理——然后在20分钟内启动并实现变现。一个API即可涵盖运行时、内存、浏览器、工具、模型和计费。
products.description: Aramb is the operating system for AI agents. Hire AI agents or build your own with one line of code ( npm install @aramb-ai/sdk ) — then launch and monetize in 20 minutes. One API for runtime, memory, browser, tools, models, and billing.

products.name: screenpipe
products.tagline: AI that records your computer work to power agents.
products.summaryZh: 记录电脑操作以驱动智能体的AI。
products.descriptionZh: screenpipe 记录你电脑上的屏幕、音频和活动，然后通过 MCP 让 AI 代理访问这些历史数据。无需重建你的一天，即可询问关于通话、错误或文档的问题。本地优先，源代码可用，支持 Mac、Windows 和 Linux。发布日优惠：使用代码 BUSINESS20 可享受年度计划折扣。截止日期为太平洋时间 8 月 28 日晚上 11:59。
products.description: screenpipe records your screen, audio, and activity on your computer, then lets AI agents access that history through MCP. Ask about calls, bugs, or documents without reconstructing your day. Local-first and source-available for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Launch-day offer: use code BUSINESS20 for a discount on annual plans. Ends August 28 at 11:59pm PT.

products.name: Glisio
products.tagline: Mac Recorder & Snap editor w/auto-zoom, audio, local MP4
products.summaryZh: Mac 录屏与快照编辑器，支持自动缩放、音频及本地 MP4 导出
products.descriptionZh: Glisio是一款用于产品演示的原生Mac应用：录制电影感片段或捕捉风格化截图。可录制屏幕、窗口或区域，支持系统音频、麦克风及可选网络摄像头。智能自动缩放跟随点击，省去繁重的时间线操作。Snap功能提供内置截图编辑器：背景、裁剪、标注，然后复制或导出。以16:9、9:16或1:1比例导出本地MP4文件。文件保留在Mac上。免费版带小水印。Pro终身版79美元一次性购买，或每月9.99美元（去除水印）。Windows版候补名单已开放。
products.description: Glisio is a native Mac app for product demos: record cinematic clips or capture styled snapshots. Record display, window, or area with system audio, mic, and optional webcam. Smart auto-zoom follows clicks so you skip a heavy timeline. Snap opens a built-in screenshot editor: background, crop, annotate, then copy or export. Export local MP4 in 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1. Files stay on your Mac. Free with a small watermark. Pro Lifetime $79 once, or $9.99/mo (removes watermark). Windows waitlist open.

products.name: Spline V2
products.tagline: Best 3D platform for the agentic era
products.summaryZh: 面向智能体时代的最佳3D平台
products.descriptionZh: 推出Spline V2，这是我们为智能体时代全面重建的3D编辑器。- 全新界面- AI智能体模式与Spline MCP- 更快的WebGPU引擎- PBR/HDR工作流- 自定义代码/脚本- 以及更多！
products.description: Introducing Spline V2, a complete rebuild of our 3d editor for the agentic era. - New UI - AI Agent Mode and Spline MCP - Faster WebGPU engine - PBR/HDR workflows - Custom Code/Scripting - and more!

products.name: SuperIntern
products.tagline: Your email and meeting assistant, inside your chat apps
products.summaryZh: 你的邮件与会议助手，就在你的聊天应用里。
products.descriptionZh: SuperIntern 2.0专为面向客户的职场人士打造，他们常耗费大量时间在邮件、会议和跟进工作上。它能学习你的写作风格，自动以你的口吻草拟回复，协助安排和总结会议，并确保跟进事项不被遗漏。在不失控的前提下，将你的客户处理能力提升10倍。每一条消息在发送前都需经过你的批准。
products.description: SuperIntern 2.0 is built for client-facing professionals who spend too much time on emails, meetings, and follow-ups. It learns how you write and automatically drafts replies in your voice, helps schedule and summarise meetings, and keeps follow-ups from slipping through the cracks. Scale your client capacity 10x without losing control. You approve every message before it sends.

products.name: Play with Putty
products.tagline: Simple, Collaborative Vibe Coding
products.summaryZh: 简洁、协作的Vibe Coding
products.descriptionZh: Play with Putty 旨在通过无摩擦的实时协作搭建，将人们聚集在一起。它提供了一个环境，让 AI 帮助人们在不打断创作流程的情况下进行搭建。
products.description: Play with Putty was designed to bring people together through frictionless, real-time, collaborative building. By providing an environment where AI enables people to build without breaking creative flow.

products.name: Revalvo
products.tagline: Run prompts on every model at once. Score. Version. Ship.
products.summaryZh: 一次在所有模型上运行提示。评分。版本管理。发布。
products.descriptionZh: Revalvo是一款本地优先的提示工程与LLM评估工作台。可并行对每个模型运行同一提示，使用40个内置评估器对响应评分，像管理代码一样对提示进行版本控制，并在数据集上批量测试——一切在上线前完成。无需账户，无托管数据库：你的API密钥仅保存在浏览器中。
products.description: Revalvo is a local-first workbench for prompt engineering and LLM evaluation. Run the same prompt against every model in parallel, score responses with 40 built-in evaluators, version prompts like code, and batch-test on datasets — before anything hits production. No account, no hosted database: your API keys stay in your browser.

products.name: CTRL Micro
products.tagline: Haptic control deck for your Mac and AI agents
products.summaryZh: 适用于Mac和AI代理的触觉控制台
products.descriptionZh: Codex Micro 已售罄，所以我们用 Apple Taptic Engine 为你的手机打造了一款。将你的 iPhone 或 iPad 变成 Mac 的触觉控制台。监控 Codex、Claude 和 Cursor，打开实时桌面视图，使用触控板和键盘，并通过 Whisper 进行本地听写。支持近距离使用或通过端到端加密的 Remote Anywhere 远程连接。你还可以构建自定义控制，让控制台适用于任何你想要的应用程序。试试看，随时掌握你的代理动态。
products.description: Codex Micro ran out of stock, so we built one for your phone using Apple Taptic Engine. Turn your iPhone or iPad into a tactile control deck for your Mac. Monitor Codex, Claude, and Cursor, open a live Desktop View, use Trackpad and Keyboard, and dictate locally using Whisper. Works nearby or through end-to-end encrypted Remote Anywhere. You can also build your own custom controls to make the deck work on any app you want. Give it a try and keep your agents in sight from anywhere.

products.name: Fide Island
products.tagline: Make your MacBook notch actually useful
products.summaryZh: 让MacBook的刘海真正派上用场
products.descriptionZh: Fide Island将MacBook的刘海变为一个紧凑流畅的命令面板。无需离开当前操作，即可控制媒体、查看日历、快速访问文件和剪贴板内容、进行快速计算，并查看系统反馈。
products.description: Fide Island turns your MacBook notch into a compact, fluid command surface. Control media, check your calendar, keep files and clipboard items close, run quick calculations, and see system feedback - without leaving what you're doing.

products.name: AureaCam
products.tagline: Real-time scoring to master the rule of thirds
products.summaryZh: 实时评分，掌握三分法则
products.descriptionZh: AureaCam是一款网页工具，能将你的相机变成照片构图教练。它实时应用三分法和黄金比例，在你取景时给拍摄打分，从0到100分。非常适合不想阅读手册、希望提升摄影技巧的初学者。它是一款PWA应用，无需安装。支持英语和西班牙语。
products.description: AureaCam is a web tool that turns your camera into a photo composition coach. It applies the rule of thirds and golden ratio in real-time, scoring your shot from 0 to 100 as you frame it. Perfect for beginner photographers who want to improve without reading manuals. It's a PWA, so no installation is required. Available in English and Spanish.

products.name: SnakeRank
products.tagline: The leaderboard is a snake. Bid your way to the head.
products.summaryZh: 排行榜是一条蛇。出价竞逐，直至榜首。
products.descriptionZh: 付费排名榜，榜单是一条自动游走的贪吃蛇。蛇身的每一格都是一家初创公司，按付费金额排序。出价高于你上方的那家，即可取而代之——出价高于所有人，则占据蛇头。排名依据承诺的总金额，因此出价会累积，攀升只需支付差额。并列时先到者优先，这意味着与榜首持平只能让你排第二，而非第一。新席位起价5美元，榜单全新——目前蛇头价格低廉。
products.description: A pay-to-rank board where the leaderboard is a self-playing snake. Every cell of its body is a startup, ordered by how much it has paid. Bid higher than the listing above you and you take its place — bid above everyone and you take the head. Rank is total dollar committed, so bids stack and climbing only ever costs you the difference. Ties go to whoever got there first, which means matching the leader buys you #2 not #1. New spots start at $5 and board is brand new — the head is cheap right now.

products.name: NotchDrop
products.tagline: A Dynamic Island experience for your Mac notch
products.summaryZh: 为你的Mac刘海带来灵动岛体验
products.descriptionZh: NotchDrop v2将MacBook的刘海变成一个更智能、更实用的工作区。直接从刘海访问生产力工具、屏幕录制与编辑、文件共享、系统状态、动态壁纸、日历、计算器、终端工具等。本次更新引入了**NotchDrop Studio**，一款内置的屏幕录制编辑器，同时新增动态壁纸、手写签名、保持唤醒功能，改进了文件共享（支持AirDrop和本地网络），并提供了可自定义主题和重新设计的界面。
products.description: NotchDrop v2 turns your MacBook notch into a smarter, more useful workspace. Access productivity tools, screen recording and editing, file sharing, system stats, live wallpapers, calendar, calculator, terminal tools, and more all directly from the notch. This update introduces **NotchDrop Studio**, a built-in screen recording editor, along with Live Wallpaper, Draw Signature, Keep Awake, improved file sharing with AirDrop and local networks, customizable themes, and a redesigned interface.

products.name: CrowdVolt
products.tagline: You're coming out tonight
products.summaryZh: 你今晚要出来吗？
products.descriptionZh: CrowdVolt是出门社交平台。发现大家热议的派对，找到你的同好，步入那些你原本不会遇见的场景。关注你喜爱的艺术家和场所，看看身边正在发生什么，然后最后一刻再做决定，毫无压力。为你想要的票自定价格，或者计划有变时即刻转出。更少的承诺，更多的随性，更多夜晚在人群中度过，而非沙发上。
products.description: CrowdVolt is the social platform for going out. Discover the parties everyone's talking about, find your people, and step into scenes you wouldn't have found otherwise. Follow your favorite artists and venues to see what's happening around you, then decide last minute without the pressure. Name your own price for tickets you want, or instantly list one if your plans change. Less commitment, more spontaneity, and more nights spent in the crowd instead of on the couch.
